caption:
Better than McD Peri Peri Chicken Burger

Macros:
C: 48 | F: 17 | P: 54
Calories: 511 per burger
Makes 2 burgers 

Ingredients
2 chicken breast, pounded 
egg + crumb coating
bowl one: 2 eggs + hot sauce + salt + pepper
bowl two: 1/2 cup cornflakes + 1 - 2 tbsp peri peri seasoning
1 tsp peri peri to sprinkle after cooking 

cheats “mayo”
1/2 cup greek yogurt
1 tsp black pepper
salt to taste
2 tsp english mustard or to your taste
2 tsp worcestershire sauce or to your taste
1 tsp tobasco 

assembly: 
2 burger buns, i will share a recipe for these soon :) 
lettuce leaves
cheese slices

.

Method: 
start by flattening your chicken breast, you can use a mallet if you have one OR a rolling pin works fine too ( add a layer of cling film if using a rolling pin) 
crush your cornflakes and add in the spices and set aside
in another bowl, beat the eggs and hot sauce together
dip your chicken in the egg and then the cornflake mix and place on a plate
preheat airfryer to 190 degrees 
air fry the patty for 10-12 minutes, this will depend on the size of the patty and thickness mine took 12 minutes, turn them half way through 

make the cheats mayo by combining all the ingredients, you can add the amounts you prefer as per your tastes

toast the burger buns with or without a little butter
layer as desired and enjoy :)
